content.short: Snekmate provides free, open-source repository of general-purpose Vyper smart contracts.
content.description: Snekmate is an open-source collection of Vyper smart contracts focused on authentication, mixins, tokens, and utility components. It serves as practical reference material for developers in the early stages of smart contract projects, illustrating concrete patterns and implementations to study and adapt. The suite can also help map security standards for data-sensitive use cases, guiding design choices around access control, reusable components, and common token functionality without prescribing a single solution.
